informal_statement: The union of pairwise intersections among four boundary pieces.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:1110-1114, the source contract is `def pairwiseOverlap (A B C D : Set PlanePoint) : Set PlanePoint := (A ∩ B) ∪ ((A ∩ C) ∪ ((A ∩ D) ∪ ((B ∩ C) ∪ ((B ∩ D) ∪ (C ∩ D)))))`. The length measure is Euclidean one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete frontier. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
